description: This Java class 'ProductPrice' represents a product's pricing details within an e-commerce application. It includes fields for standard and special prices, descriptions, availability, and associated product information, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: A Java class representing product pricing information, including price, descriptions, availability, and date-related fields for special pricing periods.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of product price descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of product price descriptions.

methods.description: Retrieves the textual representation of the price.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the textual representation of the price.

methods.description: Returns the core ProductPrice object from the core model.

methods.name: setPrice

methods.description: Retrieves the textual representation of the special price.

methods.name: setSpecialPriceText
methods.description: Sets the textual representation of the special price.

methods.name: setProduct

methods.description: Gets the start date for the special price period as a string.
